title: Whether a hostile encounter can be avoided/talked down is inconsistent and unsignaled: the gray husk at the cairn explicitly said 'It does not stir unless struck,' but the ash wolf at Twin Stones gave no such cue and offered only an attack option — after killing it the game revealed 'Lys disapproves,' with no way to have known in advance that this fight (unlike others) had a companion-approval cost or perhaps an alternate resolution.
